focus: KQ2: Frontmatter and data model — how YAML values become queryable Dataview data
noveltyJustification: 12 fully new findings (YAML type mapping, inline type inference, 3 syntax variants, duplicate→list coercion, field name sanitization, emoji keys, task implicit fields, task shorthands, date/duration details, multiline constraint, inline DQL storage gotcha, link-in-frontmatter caveat) and 2 partially new (file.frontmatter semantics, file.day derivation rules); +0.10 simplicity bonus for answering KQ2
keyQuestions: KQ2: How do frontmatter values, types, aliases, arrays, dates, nulls, and missing fields become Dataview data?
answeredQuestions: KQ2: How do frontmatter values, types, aliases, arrays, dates, nulls, and missing fields become Dataview data?

text: YAML Frontmatter Type Mapping: quoted strings→Text, unquoted numbers→Number, true/false→Boolean, ISO dates→Date, YAML lists→List, nested objects→Object, quoted [[Link]]→Link
Link-in-Frontmatter Caveat: Dataview recognizes quoted [[Link]] as Link type, but Obsidian does not treat it as a native link (no graph view, no rename updates)
Inline Field Type Inference: Key:: Value syntax auto-detects Text, Number, Boolean, Date (ISO), Duration, Link, List types; non-ISO dates become Text
Three Inline Syntax Variants: own-line (Key:: Value), bracket ([key:: value] for sentences/tasks), parenthesis ((key:: value) hides key in Reader). Tasks MUST use bracket syntax.
Duplicate Keys→List Coercion: Same key used twice in one note collects all values into a List
Field Name Sanitization: Spaces→hyphens+lowercase, formatting tokens stripped, capitalized keys have lowercase alias, keyword escape via row['keyword'], space access via row['Field With Space']
Emoji and Non-Latin Keys: UTF-8 supported; emoji keys MUST use bracket syntax; emoji character codes differ across OS (cross-platform risk)

Task/List-Level Implicit Fields: 18 fields (status, checked, completed, fullyCompleted, text, visual, line, lineCount, path, section, tags, outlinks, link, children, task, annotated, parent, blockId). Tasks inherit ALL fields from parent page.
Task Field Shorthands (Emoji): 🗓️→due, ✅→completion, ➕→created, 🛫→start, ⏳→scheduled. No bracket syntax needed. Only dates supported (no priority/recurrence).
Date auto-detection: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, YYYY-MM). Duration auto-detection: patterns like '7 hours', '16days', '4min'. Date property access: .year, .month, .weekday, etc.
file.frontmatter contains raw frontmatter as key|value text pairs — useful for checking raw values or dynamically listing keys, not for typed field access
file.day derivation: available if filename contains date (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyymmdd) OR note has a Date field/inline field — broader than local docs suggest
Inline DQL in metadata fields stores the raw expression string, not the computed result. WHERE filters compare against the raw string, making filtered queries unreliable.
Multiline text only via YAML frontmatter pipe operator (|). Inline fields: line break terminates the value. Indented continuation extends the same field but does not create multiline text.
